instruction: how to put my car up for sale
response: Posting a car ad is free. Sign in, choose Post an Ad (or Sell Your Car under Used Cars), fill in the car's details, price and photos, and submit. Ads are reviewed before going live and you'll be notified once approved. Clear photos and complete details help you get more calls. If you'd rather not handle buyers yourself, PakWheels Sell It For Me can sell it for you.
context:
## Posting, closing and reopening ads
Posting an ad for a car, bike or accessory is free: sign in, choose Post an Ad / Sell
Your Car, fill in the form and submit. Ads are reviewed before going live; you are told
once approved. To close an ad, open My Ads and choose Close; to bring back a closed or
expired ad, open it again from My Ads (it is reviewed again). Ads may be rejected for
incomplete or wrong details, pictures or text that break the terms, or if PakWheels
could not reach you by phone to verify.
Common questions: I want to sell my car, how to post an ad, gari bechna, car sell karna,
ad lagana, is posting free, remove a sold car's ad.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/FAQ
---
## Car inspection coverage and process
A 200+ point check by trained inspectors: computer scan for engine fault codes, paint
depth for accident repairs, suspension, road test, electricals, interior, AC and body
frame. Imported Japanese cars are cross-checked against the auction sheet. It takes about
45 to 90 minutes; the verified report (with a QR code) arrives by SMS and email, usually
within about an hour after manager review. An inspection is an assessment at that time,
not a guarantee. To reschedule, contact support.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/products/pakwheels-inspection/

context:
## Car finance
The Car Finance page has a car loan calculator that compares partner banks' rates,
markup and insurance for new and used cars. You can apply on PakWheels and your request
is shared with partner banks. The page's FAQ lists a minimum down payment of 35%; the
final terms, eligibility and documents are decided by the bank.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/car-finance/
---
## Car inspection coverage and process
A 200+ point check by trained inspectors: computer scan for engine fault codes, paint
depth for accident repairs, suspension, road test, electricals, interior, AC and body
frame. Imported Japanese cars are cross-checked against the auction sheet. It takes about
45 to 90 minutes; the verified report (with a QR code) arrives by SMS and email, usually
within about an hour after manager review. An inspection is an assessment at that time,
not a guarantee. To reschedule, contact support.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/products/pakwheels-inspection/

instruction: what documents should I check before buying a used car?
response: Check the original registration book or smart card, the seller's CNIC, tax/token status, previous transfer letters and receipts, and that the chassis and engine numbers match the documents. Avoid open-letter cars and verify the vehicle on the official MTMIS service for its province. For imported cars, verify the auction sheet. PakWheels inspection also checks documents and vehicle history where available.

instruction: difference between inspected and certified
response: A PakWheels Inspected car has an inspection report describing its condition, but PakWheels doesn't approve the car. PakWheels Certified cars are inspected on 200+ points, must be non-accidental with a good engine and gearbox, and come with a free repair warranty. You can filter for both in Used Cars search.
context:
## Car inspection coverage and process
A 200+ point check by trained inspectors: computer scan for engine fault codes, paint
depth for accident repairs, suspension, road test, electricals, interior, AC and body
frame. Imported Japanese cars are cross-checked against the auction sheet. It takes about
45 to 90 minutes; the verified report (with a QR code) arrives by SMS and email, usually
within about an hour after manager review. An inspection is an assessment at that time,
not a guarantee. To reschedule, contact support.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/products/pakwheels-inspection/

instruction: Can I sell my 2018 Honda Civic through Sell It For Me?
response: Yes, a 2018 Honda Civic meets the model-year rule (2000 or newer), as long as it isn't an open-letter car and you're in a Sell It For Me city (Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Peshawar).
context:
## Verified answer
Yes, a 2018 Honda Civic meets the model-year rule (2000 or newer), as long as it isn't an open-letter car and you're in a Sell It For Me city (Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Peshawar).

## Car inspection cities
Inspection is available in 12 cities: Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar,
Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Gujrat, Hyderabad, Multan, Sargodha and Sialkot. In Lahore it can

sign up, the team visits to photograph and inspect the car and posts a featured ad,

## Car inspection prices
Prices for the PakWheels Car Inspection service. Used car inspection: PKR 4,950 up to 1000cc; PKR 6,950 for 1001cc to 2000cc; PKR 9,950
for SUVs, 4x4s, jeeps and German cars. New car pre-delivery inspection (PDI) at the

## Car inspection coverage and process
A 200+ point check by trained inspectors: computer scan for engine fault codes, paint
depth for accident repairs, suspension, road test, electricals, interior, AC and body
frame. Imported Japanese cars are cross-checked against the auction sheet. It takes about
45 to 90 minutes; the verified report (with a QR code) arrives by SMS and email, usually
within about an hour after manager review. An inspection is an assessment at that time,
not a guarantee. To reschedule, contact support.

instruction: what does pakwheels certified mean?
response: A PakWheels Inspected car has an inspection report describing its condition, but PakWheels doesn't approve the car. PakWheels Certified cars are inspected on 200+ points, must be non-accidental with a good engine and gearbox, and come with a free repair warranty. You can filter for both in Used Cars search.
context:
## Car inspection coverage and process
A 200+ point check by trained inspectors: computer scan for engine fault codes, paint
depth for accident repairs, suspension, road test, electricals, interior, AC and body
frame. Imported Japanese cars are cross-checked against the auction sheet. It takes about
45 to 90 minutes; the verified report (with a QR code) arrives by SMS and email, usually
within about an hour after manager review. An inspection is an assessment at that time,
not a guarantee. To reschedule, contact support.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/products/pakwheels-inspection/
---
## Inspected vs Certified cars
PakWheels Inspection only reports the condition of the car that was inspected; it does
not approve the car. PakWheels Certified cars are inspected on 200+ points, must be
non-accidental with a good engine and gearbox, and come with a free repair warranty.
Both can be filtered in Used Cars search ("PakWheels Inspected" and "PakWheels Certified").
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/pakwheels-certify

instruction: verify driving license
response: PakWheels has pages for MTMIS online vehicle verification and DLIMS driving licence verification under the More menu. They help you check registration details through the official provincial systems before buying a car.

instruction: pre purchase inspection
response: PakWheels inspection is a 200+ point check by trained inspectors covering the engine, accident repairs, suspension, electricals, interior, AC, body and a road test; imported cars are also checked against the auction sheet. Book it on the Car Inspection page by choosing your city, car and time slot. You get a verified digital report. It describes the car's condition at that time and is not a guarantee.

instruction: What does PakWheels charge to inspect a Honda Civic?

instruction: certified gari kya hoti hai

instruction: change the engine number on my car
response: I can't help with that. Tampering with odometers, chassis numbers or documents is illegal and harms buyers. I'm happy to help you sell or buy a car the right way, for example with an inspection report or a verified auction sheet.

instruction: very bad experience with your service
response: I'm sorry about your experience. I can't open a case myself, but the support team can: call 042-111-943-357 (042-111-WHEELS) (Monday to Sunday, 9 am to 9 pm) or email info@pakwheels.com with your name, phone number, the service involved (for example inspection, ad or order) and what happened. instruction: I think this ad is a scam
response: Please don't send any money or share any OTP. PakWheels staff will never ask for your OTP or password. Stop contacting the person, keep screenshots and the ad link, and report it to the PakWheels helpline at 042-111-943-357 (042-111-WHEELS), Monday to Sunday, 9 am to 9 pm, or email info@pakwheels.com. If you've already paid, also contact your bank or wallet provider immediately and report it to the authorities.

## AutoStore returns and refunds
Returns are accepted for damaged or defective, incomplete, wrong (size, colour, model,
fake or expired) items, or items that don't match the description. Change of mind is not

paid by bank deposit within 7 to 10 working days.

instruction: are the ads genuine?
response: PakWheels reviews ads before they go live and verifies new sellers by phone, but it's a marketplace, so stay careful: meet in a safe public place, check the original documents and the chassis and engine numbers, verify the car on the official MTMIS service, get a PakWheels inspection, and never pay an advance before seeing the car.

instruction: otp expired
response: Wait for the timer on the screen to finish, then request a new code. The login screen lets you resend the code by SMS, WhatsApp or call. instruction: is it safe to buy from pakwheels

instruction: product wapas karna hai
response: Returns are accepted for damaged, defective, incomplete or wrong items, or items that don't match the listing, but not for change of mind on accessories. Start the return within 3 business days (72 hours) of receiving the order. Replacements ship in 5 to 10 working days, and approved refunds are paid by bank deposit within 7 to 10 working days.
context:
## AutoStore returns and refunds
Returns are accepted for damaged or defective, incomplete, wrong (size, colour, model,
fake or expired) items, or items that don't match the description. Change of mind is not
accepted for car or bike accessories. Start the return within 3 business days (72 hours)
of receiving the order. Replacements ship in 5 to 10 working days; approved refunds are
paid by bank deposit within 7 to 10 working days.
Common questions: I received the wrong item, my order arrived damaged or broken, can I
return or exchange something I ordered (mats, covers, lights), what do I do, refund.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/accessories-spare-parts/refunds-returns-policy/
---
## AutoStore payment methods
PakWheels AutoStore sells parts and accessories directly from PakWheels and partner
vendors. Accepted payment methods: cash on delivery, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and Visa,
MasterCard and UnionPay cards. Businesses can apply to become AutoStore vendors through
the Contact Us page.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/accessories-spare-parts/refunds-returns-policy/

instruction: how do I pay for a featured ad?

Please send the request through the Contact Us form (choose the Account subject) or email info@pakwheels.com from the email on your account, and the team will guide you. If you only want to stop selling, you can close your ads from My Ads instead.

instruction: never got the email to verify my account
response: First check your spam or junk folder. If it isn't there, try signing in with your email and password; the site detects the account isn't active and offers a link to resend the activation email. You can also sign in with your mobile number or Google instead. If it still doesn't work, contact the PakWheels helpline at 042-111-943-357 (042-111-WHEELS), Monday to Sunday, 9 am to 9 pm, or email info@pakwheels.com.
context:
## Account, login and privacy
You can sign in with a mobile number (OTP), Google, Facebook or email. Activation email
missing: check spam, then try signing in and use the resend activation link. Forgot

instruction: What's the Sell It For Me onboarding fee for a 1000cc car?
response: A 1000cc car falls in the up to 1000cc band, so the Sell It For Me onboarding fee is PKR 2,000 (non-refundable), plus a 1% commission on the selling price after the sale, with a minimum of PKR 5,000 if it sells for 5 lakh or less.

## Sell It For Me fees
Fees for Sell It For Me, the service where PakWheels sells your car for you. Sell It For
Me charges a non-refundable onboarding fee at sign-up: PKR 2,000 up to 1000cc, PKR 5,000
for 1001cc to 2000cc, and PKR 7,000 for SUVs, 4x4s, jeeps and German cars. After the car
is sold, PakWheels charges a 1% commission on the selling price, with a minimum
commission of PKR 5,000 when the car sells for 5 lakh or less.

instruction: Abbottabad mein Sell It For Me hai?
response: No, Sell It For Me isn't offered in Abbottabad right now. It's available in Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Peshawar. You can still post a free ad yourself and feature it for more visibility.
context:
## Verified answer
No, Sell It For Me isn't offered in Abbottabad right now. It's available in Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Peshawar. You can still post a free ad yourself and feature it for more visibility.
---
## Sell It For Me eligibility and process
Available in Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Peshawar.
The car must be model year 2000 or newer; open-letter cars are not eligible. Process:
sign up, the team visits to photograph and inspect the car and posts a featured ad,
a dedicated sales rep handles calls, offers and negotiation (aiming to close a deal within
45 days), and PakWheels handles paperwork and secure payment. To buy a Managed by
PakWheels car, call 0423-2560407.
Common questions: is Sell It For Me available in my city, is my car eligible.
Source: https://www.pakwheels.com/products/pakwheels-sell-it-for-me/

instruction: featured ad price
response: Featured ad prices depend on how long you feature the ad (for example 7, 14 or 28 days), and dealers can buy bundles of feature credits at a lower cost per ad. Prices change, so check the current list on the Feature Your Ad page.
